generalAbilities.name: Smoke Vision
generalAbilities.description: The ignurso ignores the Concealed condition from smoke.

defensiveAbilities.name: Lavaproof
defensiveAbilities.description: The ignurso is immune environmental fire damage and fatigue from to heat and lava

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Thermal Venting
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. The ignurso is shrouded in a cloud of smoke and ash. Creatures within the aura are Concealed, and creatures outside it are concealed to creatures within. The ignurso can deactivate or activate this aura as a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mauler
offensiveAbilities.description: The ignurso gains a +3 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against creatures it has Grabbed or Restrained.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rend
offensiveAbilities.description:
Claw

See rules...

A Rend entry lists a Strike the monster has.

Requirements The monster hit the same enemy with two consecutive Strikes of the listed type in the same round.

Effect The monster automatically deals that Strike's damage again to the enemy.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spew Lava
offensiveAbilities.description: The ignurso expels lava in a 30ft Type:cone, dealing 6d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature that fails its save also takes 1d6 Persistent,fire Damage damage. The ignurso can't Spew Lava again for 1d4 rounds.
